title: The birds have a nest to go

lines.text: The birds have nest to go,
The foxes have holes to go
But the Son of Man has no where;
For His head to lay and go.
He knocked at the Jewish door;
But the doors were tightly closed,
They crucified Him on the cross,
For they failed to see who He was.
They crucified the Lord;
They rejected the King,
But it's the plan of redemption;
By the Lamb of God.
He came to the Gentile Bride
They welcome Him with joy;
For their eyes were opened to recognise,
That Jesus was the Christ.
He promised He'd come back again,
In a form of human flesh;
To reveal the secret of His heart
To the very chosen bride.
I recognise my Lord,
I recognise His voice,
I recognise I'm a bride of Christ;
And the thought in His mind.
